question: Which fast food restaurant can I find inside 140 kilometers on the way to Alberta Banks Park, Flowery Branch, GA from Tree That Owns Itself, Athens, GA?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-83.382376 33.955038)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-83.926325 34.202543)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'fast_food'
AND ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-83.382376 33.955038)',4326)::geography, 140000)
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-83.382376 33.955038)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5);

answers.description: The foodtruck is located on the parking lot of House Of Applejay Distillery.

[3].display_name: Tree That Owns Itself, Athens, GA

[4].display_name: Alberta Banks Park, Flowery Branch, GA
